evidence.quoted_text:
def atomic(filename, data):
    filename = Path(filename)
    durable_directory(filename.parent)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(dir=filename.parent, delete=False) as stream:
        stream.write(data)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        temporary = stream.name
    os.replace(temporary, filename)
    fsync_dir(filename.parent)
evidence.reason: In current `atomic`, the staging file is created with `delete=False` and removed only by the successful `os.replace`. If `write`, `flush`, `fsync`, or `os.replace` raises, no cleanup runs and the temporary file remains; repeated failures leak files, including while `ArtifactStore.put` writes report bytes. This is an ordinary error-path/resource-leak defect in existing intended behavior, not a new requirement.
